mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the arm to the brain and spinal cord was most worthwhile because it showed how the pathways work together to guide movement.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the motor and stretch pathways was clear but repetitive; the individual fitting results added little explanation.

surprise.text: The distinction between skin deformation and muscle stretch helped me understand that the two sensory pathways supply different information.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary, although the compatible-option menu made the assembly choices straightforward rather than a test of discovering connections.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how the responsive arm depends on other body systems, though I would hope for fewer repetitive fittings.
